source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: Positive product is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Find the sign of a product with three or more integer factors by' is answered as positive product rather than negative factor.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Positive product is what produces negative factor, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Find the sign of a product with three or more integer.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: negative factor is settled by running 'Interpret an integer multiplication statement in the token-bag model': A positive multiplier places the multiplicand's tokens into the bag repeatedly; a negative — on the item about Find the sign of a product with three or more integer.

intelligence.enrichment: In a product with no zero factor, negative signs pair to make positive; an even number of negative factors gives a positive product and an odd number gives a negative product.
